items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: He was playing with Max Finkman.

ctx.x: What kind of piano player was Lobosky?

Oh, Lobosky was a fine, talented piano player. He wasn't much a jazz man, though, but I mean he was what you call a semi-jazz man. He could read and play any kind of a show that came along, but he could play some jazz too. But I mean he couldn't play like the man that featured more today, because he was a different class musician than us. In other words, he was first class musician, I'd say. Who was he playing with? Well, he was playing with Max Finkman. And there was a clarinet player. He's dead, and I can't…
